checks: A focused current-note page explains both citation directions, deduplicates repeated targets, keeps graph folded and adding relations directly available and opens citing notes with their original context
Nested references open without expanding file-tree folders, ambiguous names offer the actual paths, missing targets retain a file-search recovery; lookup uses namesOnly
Each citation direction can fail and retry independently without erasing the other, and delayed replies from an old document do not replace the current note
Graph navigation stays centered on the current file; the actual local graph can pin, follow the active document and unpin from the relation panel
Typing a new reference in the actual Vditor editor updates outgoing links from the draft without saving or repeatedly scanning incoming references
No-document and non-Markdown guidance stays understandable, and both directions plus expanded graph actions fit all six styles at desktop and narrow widths
scope: Actual App/LibraryMode/NoteRelationsPanel/Vditor/LocalGraph with isolated native lookup replies; graph workspace route is a fixture destination.
